description.zh:
排序方向。取值：

- 递减（默认）：DESC

- 递增：ASC
description.en:
The sort direction. Valid values:

- DESC (default): descending order

- ASC: ascending order.

description.zh:
查询的结束时间（时间戳，单位：毫秒）。
><warning>如果查询时间段跨度较大，查询域名的解析日志量过多，可能会导致查询超时或者查询结果不准确。></warning>
description.en:
The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
><warning>If the query time range is large and the domain name has an excessive volume of resolution logs, the query may time out or return inaccurate results.></warning>.

description.zh: 请求量突增突降子域名数报表使用
description.en: Used for the report of subdomain names with sudden increases or decreases in request volume.

description.zh:
排序参数。取值：
- createDate：按创建时间排序（为空时默认按创建时间排序）
- expireDate：按过期时间排序
description.en:
The sort parameter. Valid values:
- createDate: sorts by creation time (default if left empty)
- expireDate: sorts by expiration time.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh:
采样周期，枚举如下：

- DAY：天

- WEEK：周

- MONTH：月
description.en:
The sampling period. Valid values:

- DAY: day

- WEEK: week

- MONTH: month.
The region of the resolution cluster.

description.zh: 路由类型：cloud：云上路由。                                 local：线下路由。
description.en: The route type. Valid values: cloud: cloud route. local: on-premises route.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间（时间戳，单位：毫秒）。
description.en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

title.zh: 公网权威解析各统计指标统计详情

descriptions.zh: 实时数据的统计维度是按小时。
descriptions.en: Real-time data is aggregated by hour.
